shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on buildings, signs, vehicles, clothing and screens, except the symbols the prompt explicitly asks for. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep every person, building and object the meaning depends on inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.town: A calm, clean neighborhood in a mid-sized town on a sunny morning, eye-level photograph. Buildings are recognizable by their shape and one clear symbol only: a pharmacy by a large plain green cross above its door; a bank by a stone front with columns and an ATM beside the door; a school by a low brick building with a playground fence and children's backpacks; a train station by its platform, tracks and a waiting train. No readable signs, no other shop fronts competing for attention, no traffic.
